BM25.indexed_text: chunk text with its Title > Section header
BM25.permissions: one index of each user's readable chunks (filter before the ranking)

dense.indexed_text: chunk text with its Title > Section header

weighted.normalisation: min-max per retriever and query; 0 from a retriever that didn't return the chunk
weighted.alpha_rule: most dev queries in the top 3, then the higher dev MRR@10, then closest to 0.5

BM25+map.matching: whole phrases, case-insensitive; the documents' terms are appended, nothing removed
BM25+map.routing: an exact value (no ?, at most 4 words, a digit, @, # or ://) is not expanded
BM25+map.searches: BM25 (Day 01, the user's own index) on the expanded question

weighted+map.matching: whole phrases, case-insensitive; the documents' terms are appended, nothing removed
weighted+map.routing: an exact value (no ?, at most 4 words, a digit, @, # or ://) is not expanded

weighted+neighbours.setting_rule: most answerable dev queries with a labelled chunk in the context, then the fewest words sent on average, then previous, next, neighbours, parent
weighted+neighbours.order: the hits in rank order, then hit by hit the section just before and the one just after it in its document
weighted+neighbours.skips: a section already sent, one the user may not read, one over the budget
weighted+neighbours.permissions: every added section is checked against the user's groups (a lookup is not a search)
weighted+neighbours.control: the weighted fusion's top m, m = the number of sections sent
weighted+neighbours.first_relevant: the position of the first labelled chunk among the sections sent, or None if none was sent
weighted+neighbours.margin: the fused score gap between ranks 3 and 4: under 0.001, the hits themselves are a near tie
